jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Green Mountain Unified School District, a unified union district in the Two Rivers Supervisory Union (member towns Andover, Baltimore, Cavendish, Chester).

sources.note: Green Mountain Unified School District (Two Rivers SU, official info page; minutes in the district's Drive folders). The board has ELEVEN directors (roll calls, Feb. 19 and Aug. 20, 2026 minutes), town-allocated and elected by town electorates -- proven for Andover by the Town of Andover 2023 Town Report's GMUSD director returns. NO POSTS OR MEMBERSHIPS ARE RECORDED: no fetched official source states the per-town seat allocation or any member's town or term, and the district's adopted Articles of Agreement were not obtained (the exact missing documents are the 2017 adopted articles and the 2026 Annual Meeting Warning / March 3, 2026 town returns). Roster of record (Aug. 20, 2026, all eleven present): Lisa Sanders (Chair), Patricia Benelli, Anne Henshaw (APPOINTED Mar. 19, 2026), Shayna Kalnitsky, Donovan Nichols (Vice Chair), Lois Perlah (Clerk), Michael Ripley, Adrienne Williams, Caitlin Miller (APPOINTED Mar. 19, 2026), Katie Murphy, Jerry Ucci. Departed in 2026: Casey Leahy, Jeff Hance, Kate Lamphere, Scott Kendall, Rick Alexander.
